sents.zh: 中国的北边有很大很大的草地。
sents.en: Far to the north of China lie vast grasslands.

sents.zh: 那里没有山，只有天和草。
sents.en: There are no mountains there, only sky and grass.

sents.zh: 天冷的时候日子非常苦，风也很大。
sents.en: When the cold came life was very hard, and the wind was strong.

sents.zh: 很久以前，那里住着一些人，叫契丹。
sents.en: Long ago a people lived there called the Khitan.

sents.zh: 因为草地很大，所以他们要常常走。
sents.en: Because the grassland is so wide, they had to keep moving.

sents.zh: 他们住的地方可以拿起来带走。
sents.en: Their homes could be taken up and carried away.
They learned to ride from childhood.
Their horses were fast and fine.
Grown-ups and children alike rode well.

sents.zh: 后来他们也造了自己的字。
sents.en: Later they made a writing of their own.

sents.zh: 他们和南边的宋朝做买卖。
sents.en: They traded with the Song in the south.

sents.zh: 他们卖马，买茶、布和别的东西。
sents.en: They sold horses and bought tea, cloth and other things.

sents.zh: 虽然两边有时候也打，但是买卖一直没有停。
sents.en: Although the two sides sometimes fought, trade never stopped.

sents.zh: 所以南北的东西越来越像。
sents.en: So the things of north and south grew more alike.

sents.zh: 他们在北方住了两百多年。
sents.en: They lived in the north for more than two hundred years.
